data.revised_prompt:
Create a single 2x3 sprite animation storyboard sheet using the provided garden eel avatar as the visual identity reference for character A-Dou. Style: project-native pixel-art-inspired 2D game avatar, crisp dark outline, bright saturated colors, consistent character identity in all frames. A-Dou is a blue garden eel with purple-blue dorsal ridge, black spots, big round eye, small fins/details, emerging from tan sand. Canvas background must be 100% solid flat magenta #FF00FF. Exact layout: 2 rows by 3 columns, six equal invisible cells, no visible grid, no borders, no text, no labels. Keep all character parts, sand puffs, target marker, and effects fully inside each cell with generous magenta padding. Same scale across frames, stable bottom anchor for sand mounds. No wide slash arcs, no projectile, no large impact explosion, no detached dust cloud.

Storyboard frames left-to-right, top row then bottom row:
1 top-left: A-Dou at the enemy home tan sand mound, body coiled in preparation, about to dive; blue eel visible with purple-blue dorsal ridge, black spots, big round eye.
2 top-middle: A-Dou sinking into the enemy sand mound; only head ridge or tail tip still visible; tight sand swirl hugging the base.
3 top-right: A-Dou is underground; show an empty enemy tan sand mound at stable bottom anchor, plus a small target-player ground marker in the cell with a subtle sand ripple underneath it; no text and no UI.
4 bottom-left: A-Dou erupts from the sand underneath the target player marker with mouth open for a surprise bite; compact sand puffs close to body.
5 bottom-middle: Bite peak under the target marker, mouth open at maximum bite pose, compact sand burst close to the body only.
6 bottom-right: A-Dou retracts back through the sand and reappears at the home sand mound in a recovery pose, still same blue eel identity and stable tan mound anchor.

Use clean pixel-art-inspired sprite rendering, transparent-like composition but actual background is flat #FF00FF, no shadows outside sprites except small pixel-art sand effects. Maintain consistent eel size, outline thickness, eye design, spots, ridge color, and sand mound design across frames.
